# Filter the DataFrame for the years 2003 and 2007
df_2003 = df[df['Year'] == 2003]
df_2007 = df[df['Year'] == 2007]

# Get the unique competitions for each year
competitions_2003 = set(df_2003['Competition'].unique())
competitions_2007 = set(df_2007['Competition'].unique())

# Find the competition that appears in both years
common_competition = competitions_2003.intersection(competitions_2007)

# Extract the competition name (there should be exactly one)
answer = list(common_competition)[0] if common_competition else None
answer
